## Release 2026.1

Initial public collection:

- Chapters 01–04 in HTML and reviewed PDF form.
- One representative classroom-note PDF for Chapter 01.
- Chapters 05–14 shown honestly as an unreleased roadmap.
- No standalone scripts, syntax, datasets, labs, exercises, or project archives.
- A metadata-driven Library and a default-deny publication boundary.

Stable site URLs always present the current released version. Tagged GitHub
releases preserve cited snapshots so “current” does not mean “unrecoverable.”

Corrections that alter an interpretation, dataset, or numerical result will be
identified here. Minor copy-editing and accessibility improvements may be
grouped into a maintenance release.
